## Laughlin/Bullhead Airport

## 16-34 Runway · Taxiway A extension ph I

FNF served as the General Contractor on the Laughlin/Bullhead International Airport 16-34 Runway and Parallel Taxiway “A” Extension Phase 1 project. Work consisted of 230,000 CY of unclassified excavation, 111,000 CY of borrow, 55,000 tons of soil cement and 2,245 LF of RCP (reinforced concrete pipe) ranging from 24” to 60”. The work included 30’ cuts down to the RCP to 40’ 1:1 slopes on the fills and soil cement. Creative planning into every aspect of the project has allowed FNF to keep each activity under budget while holding quality/safety as the top priority.
